about: Result tables transcribed from published papers and one repository README, for one-to-one comparison with GlitchSAT outputs. Every value is transcribed, none is computed or estimated. Null means the cell could not be read reliably from the source text; check the PDF before using it.
transcription_note: Values were transcribed from the text layer of each PDF (web text extraction), not from a rendered page. Column alignment in PDF text layers can shift. Before quoting a value in a report, check it against the rendered PDF page named in 'where'. Numbers are kept exactly as printed (including '34.652' in SYNFI Table 1, which is probably 34,652 written with a dot as thousands separator).

sources.citation: P. Nasahl, M. Osorio, P. Vogel, M. Schaffner, T. Trippel, D. Rizzo, S. Mangard. SYNFI: Pre-Silicon Fault Analysis of an Open-Source Secure Element. IACR TCHES 2022, issue 4. Preprint arXiv:2205.04775 (v2, 2022-07-07).
sources.licence_of_source: arXiv page shows no licence; TCHES version at https://tches.iacr.org/index.php/TCHES/article/view/9813 (TCHES articles are published open access; check the page).
sources.where: arXiv:2205.04775v2, Section 4, Tables 1-8. Printed page numbers were not present in the text layer; locate by table number.

definitions_quoted.FE: any fault having an arbitrary effect to the input-output relation of the circuit
definitions_quoted.FD: an effective fault is a fault manipulating the circuit's output and the fault countermeasures did not detect it
definitions_quoted.FS: a fault changing the output of the circuit to a specific state without triggering the countermeasures
definitions_quoted.Effective [%]: how many of the total number of injected faults SYNFI considers to be effective
definitions_quoted.Total [#]: the total number of injected faults

sources.flow_note: Tables 1-6 and 8: OpenTitan internal flow, Synopsys DC with a proprietary cell library, so GE and fault counts cannot be matched exactly with open cells. Table 7 (Ibex): Yosys with Nangate45, reproducible from lowRISC/synfi examples/ibex.

sources.where: Table 3, 'Verification results, where R denotes Result, and DR denotes Desired Result.', pp. 21-22 of the PDF (page header numbering pp. 1-38; the PDF carries placeholder DOI 'XXXXXXXX'). Columns #Var, #Cls, 2CNF and Solving of FIRMER(SAT) were not transcribed.
sources.model_note: Model column printed as ζ(ne, nc, T, lm) with T = {τs, τr, τbf}. The meaning of ne, nc, lm and the τ fault types is defined in the paper's fault-model section; read it before mapping a row to a GlitchSAT bound k.
sources.symbol_note: ✓ = fault-resistant (no effective undetected fault), ✗ = not fault-resistant. Times in seconds; 'timeout' as printed.
